title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — Moving Between Plans and Terms
content:
**Terms in force.** On **Selling Plans**, a move to a higher plan takes effect immediately and bills an upgrade proration charge equal to the new plan's fee for the current term less the old plan's fee, times the remaining calendar days of the current billing period over the days in that period. An annual-term plan whose plan schedule does not allow a move to a lower plan before the term ends cannot move to a lower plan before its term ends; the seller either waits for the term end or ends the term early under the cancellation terms. Moving onto a store plan requires a store name. Moving onto a plan with a minimum trailing 12-month sales requires meeting it. A plan that is restricted cannot change plans until the restriction is lifted.

> **Retired clause — no longer in force.** "A move to a lower plan, or from the annual to the monthly term, takes effect at the plan's downgrade effective point." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

## Status condition for any plan change

| Plan status on record | Plan change possible |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Cancellation scheduled | Yes |
| Restricted | No — not until the restriction is lifted |

The status is read from the plan record in the system, for the plan being changed, before the change is made.

## The upgrade proration charge

**Clause restated.** The upgrade proration charge is the new plan's fee for the current term less the old plan's fee, multiplied by the remaining calendar days of the current billing period, divided by the number of days in that period. It is billed as a subscription fee record of the upgrade proration type, and the move takes effect immediately.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A seller on the Basic Store monthly term moves to the Premium Store monthly term with 12 calendar days left in a 30-day billing period. The monthly term fees are USD 74.95 and USD 27.95; the difference is USD 47.00; 47.00 multiplied by 12 and divided by 30 is USD 18.80.

## Other conditions on a move

| Move | Condition |
|---|---|
| Onto any store plan | A store name is required |
| Onto a plan with a minimum trailing 12-month sales | The seller's sales must meet the minimum |
| To a lower plan while on an annual term whose plan does not allow it mid-term | Not possible before the term ends; the seller waits for the term end or ends the term early under the cancellation terms |

## What a plan change records

The plan record shows the new plan, the new billing term, the store name (required when moving onto a store plan), the start of the new term and the end of a new annual term when the term changes, and the next billing date after the change.

superseded_clauses: A move to a lower plan, or from the annual to the monthly term, takes effect at the plan's downgrade effective point.
